name: Technical Design Report for the Upgrade of the ALICE Inner Tracking System
notes: Report number (CERN-LHCC-2013-024) dates LHCC submission to 2013; the journal publication (J. Phys. G 41, 087002) appeared in July 2014. `date` uses the publication month; both years are consistent with the same document.

summary.plain: The plan to replace ALICE's original inner tracker with a new, lighter, all-silicon-pixel Inner Tracking System (ITS2), installed for LHC Run 3.
summary.technical: ALICE ITS2 TDR (CERN-LHCC-2013-024, ALICE-TDR-017; J. Phys. G 41 (2014) 087002): design of the seven-layer MAPS-based (ALPIDE) Inner Tracking System replacing the original six-layer SPD/SDD/SSD ITS, installed during Long Shutdown 2 (2018-2021).
